entities.name: Illarion Mikhailovich Pryanishnikov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Illarion Mikhailovich Pryanishnikov was a Russian painter, one of the founders of the Peredvizhniki artistic cooperative, which broke away from the rigors of their time and became one of the most important Russian art schools of the late 19th century.
